description: This script facilitates remote flashing of a mec172xevb_assy6906 board via SSH, including file transfer, checksum calculation, and execution of flashing commands.

methods.name: calc_sha256
methods.description: Calculates a SHA256 hash of the SPI binary file content combined with the current timestamp to generate a unique filename.

methods.name: parse_args
methods.description: Parses command line arguments for build directory, remote host, remote temporary directory, and remote command path.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that orchestrates connecting to remote host, transferring SPI binary, executing flash command, and cleanup.
